Name: Minecraft Paintings
Author: DGlaky
Description:
Adds Minecraft paintings using the Alternative Textures Mod. This mod now includes the new paintings added to Minecraft in 1.21, as well as 4 unreleased paintings with an elemental theme. Some of the paintings are textures for fairly rare items in Stardew Valley, so to make these paintings more attainable, Exotic Palace and Squid Kid are available at the Traveling Merchant for 5000g each.
